events.name: Stories and Rhymes – Bayston Hill Library – 6 October
events.description: Free 30-minute Stories and Rhymes session for pre-school children, with stories, songs, rhymes and a simple craft. The current official listing also shows 3 November and 1 December 2026 at the same time.

events.name: Sanctum Sanctorium – Darkside of the 80s
events.description: Sanctum Sanctorium bring their Darkside of the 80s goth and alternative-rock tribute to St Leonard’s Church. Doors 18:30, alternative DJ 19:00, band 20:00, curfew 22:00.
events.accessibility: Official page confirms disabled access and toilet.
events.parking_transport: Official page says car parking is within 5–10 minutes’ walk.

events.name: Babies and Toddlers Group – Church Stretton Methodist Church
events.description: Friendly, informal group for babies and pre-school children. Children are to be accompanied by a responsible adult; parents-to-be are also welcome.
events.age_guidance: Babies and pre-school children; accompanied by a responsible adult; parents-to-be welcome

events.name: Mick McConnell & Blue Thunder – Live Blues Rock
events.description: Mick McConnell & Blue Thunder perform blues, rock and soul live at Wem Town Hall on Wednesday 28 October 2026 at 19:00. The official page does not expose a ticket price, so none is included.

events.name: Spark Young Writers (11–18) – Shrewsbury Library – 26 September
The Pikachu Art Adventure – Attingham Park
events.description: Daily 1 October to 1 November 2026, 11:00–15:30. A Pokémon/Pikachu family art adventure celebrating the Pokémon Trading Card Game 30th Celebration: discover 30 Pikachu cards by different illustrators, learn fun facts and design your own Pikachu trading card. Pick up a trail sheet at Visitor Reception. Booking not needed and there is no extra event charge, but normal Attingham admission applies.
events.accessibility: Attingham has designated Blue Badge parking, accessible toilets, a Changing Places facility, induction loops and wheelchairs/Trampers available subject to availability. Some areas include steps, cobbles or uneven terrain; see the National Trust accessibility guide before visiting.
events.parking_transport: Main visitor car park on site. National Trust also lists Bus 97 connections from Shrewsbury/Telford with a walk from the Mytton & Mermaid stop.
events.age_guidance: Pokémon fans old and young; no formal age limit stated.

events.name: Pride Trail – Shrewsbury Museum & Art Gallery
events.description: Runs 19 September to 3 October 2026. The official museum listing describes this as an All Day Event; no exact daily start/end times are published. Free family-friendly trail created by families from the museum's monthly LGBTQ+ meet-up, exploring rainbows and themes of kindness, friendship, respect, self-expression and diversity. Museum admission is also free.
